g.text: UC.26 - Security & Access Enforcement (RBAC Matrix, Session JTI & Email OTP)
Open 2D RBAC Permissions Matrix & modify role permissions
User logs in on Device B while Device A session is active
Device A sends subsequent API request with jti_A
Device A clears local credentials & redirects to Login page
Select Forgot Password & submit registered email
Block update & return Self-Lockout protection error
Persist updated grid in rbac_permissions_matrix table
Verify credentials & detect active session jti_A
Update jti_A status = REVOKED in user_active_sessions
Issue new JWT with jti_B to Device B
AuthMiddleware checks Redis blacklist & detects revoked jti_A
Increment attempts / invalidate expired OTP & return error
Hash password with bcrypt, update users table
and revoke all active user sessions
Invalidate RBAC permission cache in Redis
Set blacklist:jti_A = true in Redis (TTL = 7 days)
Send 6-digit OTP email via SMTP Server
